releaseNotes:
v0.2.15 — Fix PIN carry-over in password-change flow

- Password-change modal (admin and technician) now clears the PIN input the
  moment a 4-digit entry is accepted, so the dots reset cleanly before the
  next step. Previously, entering the current password left the dots filled
  when the "enter new password" prompt appeared, blocking further input and
  requiring the modal to be dismissed and reopened.
